answer: Standing is a relic that must pass through a prism each epoch before it can earn. The prism splits one recent job into three beams: a stranger replays the work, a second questions the agent, and a third inspects the artifact it left. Paid work unlocks only when the three beams converge on one honest story. A farmer's fakes must pass three fresh live checks per fake per epoch, while an honest agent passes once. In the harbor, a bent beam — a failed replay, an answer contradicting the record — drops the relic into quarantine, and its copies surface, betrayed by identical refraction.
